top_signals.title: Gold Pares Advance After Fed Raises Interest Rates as Expected
top_signals.summary: Gold pared gains after the Federal Reserve raised interest rates by a quarter percentage point and penciled in an additional hike later this year to step up the fight against inflation.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: 10-year Treasury yield falls as traders bet Fed rate increase can tamp down inflation
top_signals.summary: Treasury yields were lower on Wednesday after the Federal Reserve increased its overnight rate by a quarter percentage point.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Microsoft says Copilot buttons still missing in classic Outlook
top_signals.summary: Microsoft says it's still investigating a known issue that causes the Copilot and Copilot Chat buttons in Classic Outlook to disappear for some Windows users. [...]

top_signals.title: Webinar: What happens in the first hours of a Google Workspace breach
top_signals.summary: The first hours after discovering a Google Workspace breach can determine how an incident unfolds. This webinar examines real-world breaches to show which early response decisions can limit the impact and which can make matters worse. [...]
